about_the_game:
The Warnament Art Pack contains over 50 images created during the game's development. It includes banners, sketches, visual ideas which were declined, loading and victory screens, as well as illustrations for all in-game events.

To find the downloaded Art Pack, right-click on the game in your Steam Library, Properties, Local Files, Browse Local Files. You will find all the files in a directory named Art Pack.

P.S. Your purchase helps the developers continue improving the game. Thank you for your support!
